injured_at_start.name: Injured at Start
injured_at_start.card: Start the game with 2 HP fewer.

leaky_backpack.name: Leaky Backpack
leaky_backpack.card: Without a waterproof bag, every water-leak event costs 1 L of water more.

lucky_ration.name: Lucky Ration
lucky_ration.card: Start the game with 1500 kcal of extra food.

fragile_shoelaces.name: Fragile Shoelaces
fragile_shoelaces.card: Without duct tape, the first boot-lace snap makes you lose 1 HP.

cold_sensitive.name: Cold Sensitive
cold_sensitive.card: Unprotected cold events make you lose 1 HP more. A down jacket cancels this.

heat_resistant.name: Heat Resistant
heat_resistant.card: Unprotected hot-weather and sun events make you lose 1 HP less.

climber.name: Climber
climber.card: Unprotected slip or fall events make you lose 1 HP less.

allergy_prone.name: Allergy Prone
allergy_prone.card: Unprotected bee-sting, insect or allergy events make you lose 1 HP more, unless you carry allergy medication.

old_batteries.name: Old Batteries
old_batteries.card: Without spare batteries, the first headlamp-dead event makes you lose 1 HP more.

hot_drink_lover.name: Hot Drink Lover
hot_drink_lover.card: Tea and hot-drink events give you 1 extra HP if you carry a stove and a pot.

clean_freak.name: Clean Freak
clean_freak.card: Without disinfectant wipes, the first scavenged-food event makes you lose 1 HP more.

water_hoarder.name: Water Hoarder
water_hoarder.card: If you packed more than 5 L of water, lose 1 HP every 5th day (optional for teacher).

light_pack_expert.name: Light Pack Expert
light_pack_expert.card: If your backpack weighs at most two-thirds of the weight limit (10 kg with a 15 kg limit), gain 1 HP every 5th day.

repair_expert.name: Repair Expert
repair_expert.card: With a repair kit, unprotected equipment-damage events make you lose 1 HP less.

animal_friend.name: Animal Friend
animal_friend.card: Calm wildlife encounters never cost you HP (friendly ones still cheer you up).

night_walker.name: Night Walker
night_walker.card: With a headlamp, unprotected navigation events make you lose 1 HP less.

coffee_bonus.name: Coffee Bonus
coffee_bonus.card: With a coffee press and a stove, fatigue, headache and cramp events cost you no HP.

picky_eater.name: Picky Eater
picky_eater.card: Without a stove to cook, raw-food events (mushrooms, fish, berries) make you lose 1 HP more, even if otherwise protected.

backup_hammock.name: Backup Hammock
backup_hammock.card: Without a tent or tarp, rainy nights make you lose 1 HP less.

old_rope.name: Old Rope
old_rope.card: Without a rope, the first cliff or river-crossing event makes you lose 1 HP more.
